scoreEvidence.fidelity: The previous sweep is closer to the raw CT surface globally. The candidate still follows both poles and the medial turn across all three protected sections, with a worst sampled distance of 1.63 mm there and 2.47 mm globally.
scoreEvidence.form: The lower pole loses most of its horizontal terraces. A shallow step remains at the inferior tip. In reverse oblique the recess stays deep and both rounded ends remain distinct.
scoreEvidence.readability: I could follow the two ends and the open medial indentation in the registered section. The oblique view hides the depth of the recess behind the flank. Rotating the scene exposes it.
scoreEvidence.economy: The exact previous sweep uses 25,752 triangles and 463,568 bytes. r01 uses 4,800 and 86,432 bytes (81% less). The 24-view projected outline deviates at most 0.71 px at 3 px/mm after reducing the smooth surface.

records.disposition: Adopt for pole and recess orientation
